title: HookRunService
responsibility: Runs the pre-push gate: each pushed source commit must have a passing verification, which is then attached.

inputs.name: HookRunService.constructor.root
inputs.description: The repository root used by verification and history calls. The constructor stores the string as-is and does not normalize or validate the path.

inputs.name: HookRunService.prePush.input
inputs.description: Raw pre-push hook text passed to pushedRefs to select commits. This class does not parse the text itself; selected commits are processed sequentially.

outputs.name: HookRunService.prePush
outputs.description: On success, returns the commits selected from the input split into verified and blocked arrays; a commit is verified when its record has no failures, and blocked otherwise. Each record is attached to history before its result is added, and an existing passing record avoids a new verification.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unchanged if pushedRefs throws or verifyRun/historyAttach rejects; verifyCheck rejections are caught and treated as no prior passing proof.
